goals: To verify the correct functionality and behavior of the LoadDataTasklet's data loading logic.
To ensure the Spring Batch job, including its configuration and end-to-end execution, is correctly set up and completes successfully.
activities: Initialize mock objects for LoadDataTaskletTest.
Define a SQL query string.
Create mock data representing database query results.
Configure the mock JdbcTemplate to return specific mock data when a specific SQL query is executed.
Execute the LoadDataTasklet.
Assert that the LoadDataTasklet execution status is FINISHED.
Verify that JdbcTemplate.queryForList was called exactly once with the specified SQL query.
Configure the mock JdbcTemplate to return an empty list for any SQL query.
Execute the LoadDataTasklet.
Assert that the LoadDataTasklet execution status is FINISHED.
Assert that the 'loadDataJob' object is not null.
Assert that the 'loadDataStep' object is not null.
Assert that the name of 'loadDataJob' is 'loadDataJob'.
Assert that the name of 'loadDataStep' is 'loadDataStep'.
Launch the 'loadDataJob' with empty job parameters.
Assert that the job execution status is not unsuccessful.
Assert that the job exit code is 'COMPLETED'.
Initialize mock objects for JobRunnerTest.
Configure the mock JobLauncher to return null when any job is launched with any parameters.
Execute the JobRunner.
Verify that JobLauncher.run was called exactly once with 'loadDataJob' and any job parameters.
